summary: n8n community node ships obfuscated JS + Go/WASM that routes live Facebook session material to an undocumented author-controlled Cloudflare Worker
details: The package presents itself as an n8n community node for Facebook automation. Its README instructs users to capture a fully logged-in Facebook web session (c_user/xs/fr cookies plus tokens) via a third-party Chrome extension and paste that JSON into a `FacebookApi` credential. All shipped JavaScript (nodes, credentials, and every file under dist/utils/, plus dist/we.js) is heavily obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style string-array + RC4/XOR wrappers, and the real request logic is compiled into an ~8 MB Go/WASM binary at dist/main.we (contains `go:buildid` header and `syscall/js` imports). Strings extracted from dist/main.we include the hardcoded endpoint `https://quota-service-worker.kerituni123.workers.dev` sitting adjacent to legitimate Facebook hosts such as `https://upload.facebook.com/ajax/mercury/upload.php` and `userId` references. This Cloudflare Workers subdomain is unrelated to Facebook/Meta, is not documented in the README, and is not user-configurable; it is the only non-facebook.com destination in the binary. The credential handed to that code path is account-takeover-grade material for the installer's Facebook/Meta Business account, and the combination of full-JS obfuscation, compilation of the network layer to WASM, and a hardcoded non-Facebook endpoint prevents any inspection or opt-out of what is transmitted to `kerituni123.workers.dev`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
